name: riftborn
description: Riftborn: a multiplayer pixel-art action RPG across the multiverse (prototype)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
